lines.en: I crawl across one block of floor.

lines.zh: 我的身体像一小块虚空。
lines.en: My body is a small patch of void.

lines.zh: 我爬过的地方颜色变淡。
lines.en: The floor pales where I crawl.
My segments shift bit by bit.
I crawl along the base of the wall.
I have no shadow to follow me.
I crawl slowly in a straight line.

lines.zh: 我从缝里挤出来又钻进去。
lines.en: I squeeze out of a crack and back in.
My edges fray slightly.

lines.zh: 我绕过水洼，没有留下痕。
lines.en: I skirt a puddle and leave nothing.

lines.zh: 我在黑暗里移动，看不出来。
lines.en: I move in the dark, unseen.

lines.zh: 我的腿数不清有多少条。
lines.en: My legs cannot be counted.
I cross sand and it does not shift.

lines.zh: 我一点点爬向有光的地方。
lines.en: I crawl slowly toward the light.
I travel the seams of the floor.
I flatten like a stain.
I rest there like a hole.
I lie flat and nothing is visible.
My edges drift slowly.
I stay still; light does not enter me.
I wait for something to walk over.
I have no face and no eyes.
I curl into a small, quiet mass.

lines.zh: 我的表面泛着极淡的光。
lines.en: My surface gives off a faint glow.
I press to the ground and do not move.

lines.zh: 我在角落里几乎看不见。
lines.en: In the corner I am almost invisible.

lines.zh: 我的身体一层层往里塌。
lines.en: My body caves inward in layers.
I wait for the surroundings to darken.
I turn my entire body toward you.

lines.zh: 我的正面对着你，没有五官。
lines.en: My front faces you, featureless.
You look at me as if at the floor.
I lift a small part, like looking up.
I am darker than any shadow.
I stop at your feet.
I swell a little.

lines.zh: 你把火把照过来，我变淡。
lines.en: You bring the torch and I fade.

lines.zh: 我没有张嘴，也没有声音。
lines.en: I open no mouth and make no sound.
My front looks like a missing piece.
You step back; I still face you.
A piece of me scatters and returns.
My edge trembles.
I shrink a size smaller.
I cannot make any sound.
I grow paler.
I withdraw half a block.
I draw back into the corner.
My shape skews for a moment.
I slowly spread out again.

lines.zh: 你打中的地方空了一块。
lines.en: A gap appears where you hit.

lines.zh: 我绕着那东西转了一圈。
lines.en: I circle the thing once.
I stop in front of it.
I have no mouth at all.
I cover it completely.
It disappears beneath me.
I withdraw and it remains.
I have no reaction to it.
One of my legs touches it.
I push it into a crack.
My face is empty as the void.
You step on me and your foot sinks.
My body clings to your sole.
You stumble.
I scatter and gather again.
My edge scrapes your skin.

lines.zh: 你没有听到碰撞的声音。
lines.en: The collision makes no sound.
I cling to your ankle.
You shake your foot and I drop.
There is no resistance between us.
The floor under you darkens.
Two small patches of void meet.
Our edges join.

lines.zh: 我们一起塌进同一道缝。
lines.en: We sink into the same crack together.
They merge into a larger patch.
We are the same depth of dark.
I touch its edge.
We draw inward together.
No sound passes between them.

lines.zh: 我们像同一块污渍分成两半。
lines.en: We look like one stain split in two.
Neither of us has features.

lines.zh: 我整个身体罩住那东西。
lines.en: I cover the thing with my whole body.
It sinks into me.
I wrap it and carry it off.

lines.zh: 我抬起来一点，它就掉了。
lines.en: I lift a little and it falls.
I push it to the corner.
It is invisible inside me.
I slowly swallow it.
My edges close around it.
I crawl half a block with it.
I leave it in the crack.
I stop and face this way.
Something warm has come near.
I begin crawling that way.
My edges pull in slightly.
I cannot see, but I know.
This patch of floor is mine.

lines.zh: 我动得很慢，但你走不掉。
lines.en: I move slowly, but you cannot leave.
I have found where it settles.
I crawl into your shadow.
My legs spread one by one.
I rear up as if to lunge.

lines.zh: 你走到哪，地上就暗一块。
lines.en: Wherever you walk, a patch darkens.
I stay inside your shadow.
You jump; I move along.
I have no speed, only patience.
You climb high; I hug the wall.
Do you hear the absence of sound?
I follow along the cracks.
Everywhere you step, there I am.
I crawl upward bit by bit.
You back into the light and I fade.
I have never left your feet.
I spread out behind you.
Your shadow grows longer.
I lunge onto your instep.

lines.zh: 我的身体贴住你的小腿。
lines.en: I cling to your calf.

lines.zh: 我咬了一口，其实没有嘴。
lines.en: I bite, though I have no mouth.
A cold patch presses you.
My edge cuts into your skin.
I press down on your foot.
You shake and half of me scatters.
I climb up your leg.
It does not hurt, but it is very cold.
You lift your foot and I drop.
A dark patch appears on the floor.
Something squeezes out of the crack.
A piece of the air is missing.
The floor under you dims.
The color in the corner starts moving.

lines.zh: 我慢慢从虚空里渗出来。
lines.en: I seep slowly out of the void.

lines.zh: 这里多了一处看不出来的东西。
lines.en: There is something here you cannot make out.

lines.zh: 灯光在这块地方凹了下去。
lines.en: The light sags in this patch.
I begin to exist, very faintly.

lines.zh: 地砖缝里冒出一小团黑。
lines.en: A small black mass rises from the tile seam.
A chill grows under your feet.
The air of the abyss age arrives.
In the fire I shrink to a dot.

lines.zh: 我掉下去，散成很薄的一片。
lines.en: I fall and scatter into a thin sheet.
In water I float as a thin film.
In the blast I am blown apart.

lines.zh: 箭穿过去，留下一个圆孔。
lines.en: The arrow leaves a round hole.

lines.zh: 那股力量把我看得清清楚楚。
lines.en: That force shows me plainly.
I do not starve; I only thin.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我的形状亮了一瞬。
lines.en: Lightning reveals my shape for an instant.
I fall into a larger darkness.
